chunks.sanskrit: pānta̠mā vo̠ andha̍sa̠ indra̍ma̠bhi pra gā̍yata |
indra̠ inno̍ ma̠hānāṃ̍ dā̠tā vājā̍nāṃ nṛ̠tuḥ |
śikṣā̍ ṇa indra rā̠ya ā pu̠ru vi̠dvām̐ ṛ̍cīṣama |
va̠yamu̍ tvā śatakrato̠ gāvo̠ na yava̍se̠ṣvā |
sa no̍ vṛṣa̠ntsani̍ṣṭhayā̠ saṃ gho̠rayā̍ dravi̠tnvā |
vi̠dmā hi yaste̍ adriva̠stvāda̍ttaḥ satya somapāḥ |
indrā̍ya̠ madva̍ne su̠taṃ pari̍ ṣṭobhantu no̠ gira̍: |
yasmi̠nviśvā̠ adhi̠ śriyo̠ raṇa̍nti sa̠pta saṃ̠sada̍: |
araṃ̍ ta indra ku̠kṣaye̠ somo̍ bhavatu vṛtrahan |
araṃ̠ hi ṣma̍ su̠teṣu̍ ṇa̠: some̍ṣvindra̠ bhūṣa̍si |
e̠vā hyasi̍ vīra̠yure̠vā śūra̍ u̠ta sthi̠raḥ |
mo ṣu bra̠hmeva̍ tandra̠yurbhuvo̍ vājānāṃ pate |
mā na̍ indrā̠bhyā̠3diśa̠: sūro̍ a̠ktuṣvā ya̍man |
tvayedi̍ndra yu̠jā va̠yaṃ prati̍ bruvīmahi̠ spṛdha̍: |
nava̠ yo na̍va̠tiṃ puro̍ bi̠bheda̍ bā̠hvo̍jasā |
yadvā̍ pravṛddha satpate̠ na ma̍rā̠ iti̠ manya̍se |
ye somā̍saḥ parā̠vati̠ ye a̍rvā̠vati̍ sunvi̠re |
indra̠: sa dāma̍ne kṛ̠ta oji̍ṣṭha̠: sa made̍ hi̠taḥ |
gi̠rā vajro̠ na sambhṛ̍ta̠: saba̍lo̠ ana̍pacyutaḥ |
du̠rge ci̍nnaḥ su̠gaṃ kṛ̍dhi gṛṇā̠na i̍ndra girvaṇaḥ |
yasya̍ te̠ nū ci̍dā̠diśaṃ̠ na mi̠nanti̍ sva̠rājya̍m |
adhā̍ te̠ apra̍tiṣkutaṃ de̠vī śuṣmaṃ̍ saparyataḥ |
vi yadahe̠radha̍ tvi̠ṣo viśve̍ de̠vāso̠ akra̍muḥ |
śru̠taṃ vo̍ vṛtra̠hanta̍maṃ̠ pra śardhaṃ̍ carṣaṇī̠nām |
kayā̠ tvaṃ na̍ ū̠tyā'bhi pra ma̍ndase vṛṣan |
kasya̠ vṛṣā̍ su̠te sacā̍ ni̠yutvā̍nvṛṣa̠bho ra̍ṇat |
a̠bhī ṣu ṇa̠stvaṃ ra̠yiṃ ma̍ndasā̠naḥ sa̍ha̠sriṇa̍m |
patnī̍vantaḥ su̠tā i̠ma u̠śanto̍ yanti vī̠taye̍ |
tubhyaṃ̠ somā̍: su̠tā i̠me stī̠rṇaṃ ba̠rhirvi̍bhāvaso |
ā te̠ dakṣaṃ̠ vi ro̍ca̠nā dadha̠dratnā̠ vi dā̠śuṣe̍ |
sa no̠ viśvā̠nyā bha̍ra suvi̠tāni̍ śatakrato |
upa̍ no̠ hari̍bhiḥ su̠taṃ yā̠hi ma̍dānāṃ pate |
dvi̠tā yo vṛ̍tra̠hanta̍mo vi̠da indra̍: śa̠takra̍tuḥ |
indra̍ i̠ṣe da̍dātu na ṛbhu̠kṣaṇa̍mṛ̠bhuṃ ra̠yim |
yasyā̍ de̠vā u̠pasthe̍ vra̠tā viśve̍ dhā̠raya̍nte |
tatsu no̠ viśve̍ a̠rya ā sadā̍ gṛṇanti kā̠rava̍: |
asti̠ somo̍ a̠yaṃ su̠taḥ piba̍ntyasya ma̠ruta̍: |
piba̍nti mi̠tro a̍rya̠mā tanā̍ pū̠tasya̠ varu̍ṇaḥ |
u̠to nva̍sya̠ joṣa̠mām̐ indra̍: su̠tasya̠ goma̍taḥ |
ā ye viśvā̠ pārthi̍vāni pa̠pratha̍nroca̠nā di̠vaḥ |
tyānnu pū̠tada̍kṣaso di̠vo vo̍ maruto huve |
tyānnu ye vi roda̍sī tasta̠bhurma̠ruto̍ huve |
tyaṃ nu māru̍taṃ ga̠ṇaṃ gi̍ri̠ṣṭhāṃ vṛṣa̍ṇaṃ huve |
ā tvā̠ giro̍ ra̠thīri̠vā'sthu̍: su̠teṣu̍ girvaṇaḥ |
a̠bhi tvā̠ sama̍nūṣa̠tendra̍ va̠tsaṃ na mā̠tara̍: || 1 ||
ā tvā̍ śu̠krā a̍cucyavuḥ su̠tāsa̍ indra girvaṇaḥ |
pibā̠ tva1syāndha̍sa̠ indra̠ viśvā̍su te hi̠tam || 2 ||
pibā̠ somaṃ̠ madā̍ya̠ kamindra̍ śye̠nābhṛ̍taṃ su̠tam |
tvaṃ hi śaśva̍tīnāṃ̠ patī̠ rājā̍ vi̠śāmasi̍ || 3 ||
śru̠dhī havaṃ̍ tira̠ścyā indra̠ yastvā̍ sapa̠ryati̍ |
tamu̍ ṣṭavāma̠ yaṃ gira̠ indra̍mu̠kthāni̍ vāvṛ̠dhuḥ |
eto̠ nvindraṃ̠ stavā̍ma śu̠ddhaṃ śu̠ddhena̠ sāmnā̍ |
indra̍ śu̠ddho na̠ ā ga̍hi śu̠ddhaḥ śu̠ddhābhi̍rū̠tibhi̍: |
śu̠ddho ra̠yiṃ ni dhā̍raya śu̠ddho ma̍maddhi so̠myaḥ || 8 ||
indra̍ śu̠ddho hi no̍ ra̠yiṃ śu̠ddho ratnā̍ni dā̠śuṣe̍ |
śu̠ddho vṛ̠trāṇi̍ jighnase śu̠ddho vājaṃ̍ siṣāsasi || 9 ||
a̠smā u̠ṣāsa̠ āti̍ranta̠ yāma̠mindrā̍ya̠ nakta̠mūrmyā̍: su̠vāca̍: |
a̠smā āpo̍ mā̠tara̍: sa̠pta ta̍sthu̠rnṛbhya̠starā̍ya̠ sindha̍vaḥ supā̠rāḥ || 1 ||
ati̍viddhā vithu̠reṇā̍ ci̠dastrā̠ triḥ sa̠pta sānu̠ saṃhi̍tā girī̠ṇām |
na tadde̠vo na martya̍stuturyā̠dyāni̠ pravṛ̍ddho vṛṣa̠bhaśca̠kāra̍ || 2 ||
indra̍sya̠ vajra̍ āya̠so nimi̍śla̠ indra̍sya bā̠hvorbhūyi̍ṣṭha̠moja̍: |
śī̠rṣannindra̍sya̠ krata̍vo nire̠ka ā̠sanneṣa̍nta̠ śrutyā̍ upā̠ke || 3 ||
manye̍ tvā ya̠jñiyaṃ̍ ya̠jñiyā̍nāṃ̠ manye̍ tvā̠ cyava̍na̠macyu̍tānām |
manye̍ tvā̠ satva̍nāmindra ke̠tuṃ manye̍ tvā vṛṣa̠bhaṃ ca̍rṣaṇī̠nām || 4 ||
ā yadvajraṃ̍ bā̠hvori̍ndra̠ dhatse̍ mada̠cyuta̠maha̍ye̠ hanta̠vā u̍ |
pra parva̍tā̠ ana̍vanta̠ pra gāva̠: pra bra̠hmāṇo̍ abhi̠nakṣa̍nta̠ indra̍m || 5 ||
tamu̍ ṣṭavāma̠ ya i̠mā ja̠jāna̠ viśvā̍ jā̠tānyava̍rāṇyasmāt |
indre̍ṇa mi̠traṃ di̍dhiṣema gī̠rbhirupo̠ namo̍bhirvṛṣa̠bhaṃ vi̍śema || 6 ||
vṛ̠trasya̍ tvā śva̠sathā̠dīṣa̍māṇā̠ viśve̍ de̠vā a̍jahu̠rye sakhā̍yaḥ |
ma̠rudbhi̍rindra sa̠khyaṃ te̍ a̠stvathe̠mā viśvā̠: pṛta̍nā jayāsi || 7 ||
triḥ ṣa̠ṣṭistvā̍ ma̠ruto̍ vāvṛdhā̠nā u̠srā i̍va rā̠śayo̍ ya̠jñiyā̍saḥ |
upa̠ tvema̍: kṛ̠dhi no̍ bhāga̠dheyaṃ̠ śuṣmaṃ̍ ta e̠nā ha̠viṣā̍ vidhema || 8 ||
ti̠gmamāyu̍dhaṃ ma̠rutā̠manī̍kaṃ̠ kasta̍ indra̠ prati̠ vajraṃ̍ dadharṣa |
a̠nā̠yu̠dhāso̠ asu̍rā ade̠vāśca̠kreṇa̠ tām̐ apa̍ vapa ṛjīṣin || 9 ||
ma̠ha u̠grāya̍ ta̠vase̍ suvṛ̠ktiṃ prera̍ya śi̠vata̍māya pa̠śvaḥ |
girvā̍hase̠ gira̠ indrā̍ya pū̠rvīrdhe̠hi ta̠nve̍ ku̠vida̠ṅga veda̍t || 10 ||
u̠kthavā̍hase vi̠bhve̍ manī̠ṣāṃ druṇā̠ na pā̠ramī̍rayā na̠dīnā̍m |
ni spṛ̍śa dhi̠yā ta̠nvi̍ śru̠tasya̠ juṣṭa̍tarasya ku̠vida̠ṅga veda̍t || 11 ||
tadvi̍viḍḍhi̠ yatta̠ indro̠ jujo̍ṣatstu̠hi su̍ṣṭu̠tiṃ nama̠sā vi̍vāsa |
upa̍ bhūṣa jarita̠rmā ru̍vaṇyaḥ śrā̠vayā̠ vācaṃ̍ ku̠vida̠ṅga veda̍t || 12 ||
ava̍ dra̠pso aṃ̍śu̠matī̍matiṣṭhadiyā̠naḥ kṛ̠ṣṇo da̠śabhi̍: sa̠hasrai̍: |
nabho̠ na kṛ̠ṣṇama̍vatasthi̠vāṃsa̠miṣyā̍mi vo vṛṣaṇo̠ yudhya̍tā̠jau || 14 ||
tvaṃ ha̠ tyatsa̠ptabhyo̠ jāya̍māno'śa̠trubhyo̍ abhava̠: śatru̍rindra |
gū̠ḷhe dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī anva̍vindo vibhu̠madbhyo̠ bhuva̍nebhyo̠ raṇaṃ̍ dhāḥ || 16 ||
tvaṃ ha̠ tyada̍pratimā̠namojo̠ vajre̍ṇa vajrindhṛṣi̠to ja̍ghantha |
tvaṃ śuṣṇa̠syāvā̍tiro̠ vadha̍trai̠stvaṃ gā i̍ndra̠ śacyeda̍vindaḥ || 17 ||
tvaṃ ha̠ tyadvṛ̍ṣabha carṣaṇī̠nāṃ gha̠no vṛ̠trāṇāṃ̍ tavi̠ṣo ba̍bhūtha |
sa su̠kratū̠ raṇi̍tā̠ yaḥ su̠teṣvanu̍ttamanyu̠ryo ahe̍va re̠vān |
ya eka̠ innaryapāṃ̍si̠ kartā̠ sa vṛ̍tra̠hā pratīda̠nyamā̍huḥ || 19 ||
sa prā̍vi̠tā ma̠ghavā̍ no'dhiva̠ktā sa vāja̍sya śrava̠sya̍sya dā̠tā || 20 ||
sa vṛ̍tra̠hendra̍ ṛbhu̠kṣāḥ sa̠dyo ja̍jñā̠no havyo̍ babhūva |
kṛ̠ṇvannapāṃ̍si̠ naryā̍ pu̠rūṇi̠ somo̠ na pī̠to havya̠: sakhi̍bhyaḥ || 21 ||
yā i̍ndra̠ bhuja̠ ābha̍ra̠: sva̍rvām̠̐ asu̍rebhyaḥ |
sto̠tāra̠minma̍ghavannasya vardhaya̠ ye ca̠ tve vṛ̠ktaba̍rhiṣaḥ || 1 ||
yaja̍māne sunva̠ti dakṣi̍ṇāvati̠ tasmi̠ntaṃ dhe̍hi̠ mā pa̠ṇau || 2 ||
svaiḥ ṣa evai̍rmumura̠tpoṣyaṃ̍ ra̠yiṃ sa̍nu̠tardhe̍hi̠ taṃ tata̍: || 3 ||
ata̍stvā gī̠rbhirdyu̠gadi̍ndra ke̠śibhi̍: su̠tāvām̠̐ ā vi̍vāsati || 4 ||
yatpārthi̍ve̠ sada̍ne vṛtrahantama̠ yada̠ntari̍kṣa̠ ā ga̍hi || 5 ||
sa na̠: some̍ṣu somapāḥ su̠teṣu̍ śavasaspate |
mā na̍ indra̠ parā̍ vṛṇa̠gbhavā̍ naḥ sadha̠mādya̍: |
tvaṃ na̍ ū̠tī tvaminna̠ āpyaṃ̠ mā na̍ indra̠ parā̍ vṛṇak || 7 ||
a̠sme i̍ndra̠ sacā̍ su̠te ni ṣa̍dā pī̠taye̠ madhu̍ |
kṛ̠dhī ja̍ri̠tre ma̍ghava̠nnavo̍ ma̠hada̠sme i̍ndra̠ sacā̍ su̠te || 8 ||
na tvā̍ de̠vāsa̍ āśata̠ na martyā̍so adrivaḥ |
viśvā̍ jā̠tāni̠ śava̍sābhi̠bhūra̍si̠ na tvā̍ de̠vāsa̍ āśata || 9 ||
viśvā̠: pṛta̍nā abhi̠bhūta̍raṃ̠ naraṃ̍ sa̠jūsta̍takṣu̠rindraṃ̍ jaja̠nuśca̍ rā̠jase̍ |
kratvā̠ vari̍ṣṭhaṃ̠ vara̍ ā̠muri̍mu̠togramoji̍ṣṭhaṃ ta̠vasaṃ̍ tara̠svina̍m || 10 ||
sva̍rpatiṃ̠ yadīṃ̍ vṛ̠dhe dhṛ̠tavra̍to̠ hyoja̍sā̠ samū̠tibhi̍: || 11 ||
ne̠miṃ na̍manti̠ cakṣa̍sā me̠ṣaṃ viprā̍ abhi̠svarā̍ |
su̠dī̠tayo̍ vo a̠druho'pi̠ karṇe̍ tara̠svina̠: samṛkva̍bhiḥ || 12 ||
tamindraṃ̍ johavīmi ma̠ghavā̍namu̠graṃ sa̠trā dadhā̍na̠mapra̍tiṣkutaṃ̠ śavāṃ̍si |
maṃhi̍ṣṭho gī̠rbhirā ca̍ ya̠jñiyo̍ va̠varta̍drā̠ye no̠ viśvā̍ su̠pathā̍ kṛṇotu va̠jrī || 13 ||
tvaṃ pura̍ indra ci̠kide̍nā̠ vyoja̍sā śaviṣṭha śakra nāśa̠yadhyai̍ |
tvadviśvā̍ni̠ bhuva̍nāni vajri̠ndyāvā̍ rejete pṛthi̠vī ca̍ bhī̠ṣā || 14 ||
tanma̍ ṛ̠tami̍ndra śūra citra pātva̠po na va̍jrinduri̠tāti̍ parṣi̠ bhūri̍ |
ka̠dā na̍ indra rā̠ya ā da̍śasyervi̠śvapsnya̍sya spṛha̠yāyya̍sya rājan || 15 ||
indrā̍ya̠ sāma̍ gāyata̠ viprā̍ya bṛha̠te bṛ̠hat |
a̠bhi hi sa̍tya somapā u̠bhe ba̠bhūtha̠ roda̍sī |
adhā̠ hī̍ndra girvaṇa̠ upa̍ tvā̠ kāmā̍nma̠haḥ sa̍sṛ̠jmahe̍ |
yu̠ñjanti̠ harī̍ iṣi̠rasya̠ gātha̍yo̠rau ratha̍ u̠ruyu̍ge |
tvaṃ na̍ i̠ndrā bha̍ram̠̐ ojo̍ nṛ̠mṇaṃ śa̍takrato vicarṣaṇe |
tvaṃ hi na̍: pi̠tā va̍so̠ tvaṃ mā̠tā śa̍takrato ba̠bhūvi̍tha |
sa i̍ndra̠ stoma̍vāhasāmi̠ha śru̠dhyupa̠ svasa̍ra̠mā ga̍hi || 1 ||
matsvā̍ suśipra hariva̠stadī̍mahe̠ tve ā bhū̍ṣanti ve̠dhasa̍: |
vasū̍ni jā̠te jana̍māna̠ oja̍sā̠ prati̍ bhā̠gaṃ na dī̍dhima || 3 ||
ana̍rśarātiṃ vasu̠dāmupa̍ stuhi bha̠drā indra̍sya rā̠taya̍: |
so a̍sya̠ kāmaṃ̍ vidha̠to na ro̍ṣati̠ mano̍ dā̠nāya̍ co̠daya̍n || 4 ||
a̠śa̠sti̠hā ja̍ni̠tā vi̍śva̠tūra̍si̠ tvaṃ tū̍rya taruṣya̠taḥ || 5 ||
anu̍ te̠ śuṣmaṃ̍ tu̠raya̍ntamīyatuḥ kṣo̠ṇī śiśuṃ̠ na mā̠tarā̍ |
viśvā̍ste̠ spṛdha̍: śnathayanta ma̠nyave̍ vṛ̠traṃ yadi̍ndra̠ tūrva̍si || 6 ||
a̠yaṃ ta̍ emi ta̠nvā̍ pu̠rastā̠dviśve̍ de̠vā a̠bhi mā̍ yanti pa̠ścāt |
ya̠dā mahyaṃ̠ dīdha̍ro bhā̠gami̠ndrā''dinmayā̍ kṛṇavo vī̠ryā̍ṇi || 1 ||
dadhā̍mi te̠ madhu̍no bha̠kṣamagre̍ hi̠taste̍ bhā̠gaḥ su̠to a̍stu̠ soma̍: |
asa̍śca̠ tvaṃ da̍kṣiṇa̠taḥ sakhā̠ me'dhā̍ vṛ̠trāṇi̍ jaṅghanāva̠ bhūri̍ || 2 ||
pra su stomaṃ̍ bharata vāja̠yanta̠ indrā̍ya sa̠tyaṃ yadi̍ sa̠tyamasti̍ |
nendro̍ a̠stīti̠ nema̍ u tva āha̠ ka īṃ̍ dadarśa̠ kama̠bhi ṣṭa̍vāma || 3 ||
a̠yama̍smi jarita̠: paśya̍ me̠ha viśvā̍ jā̠tānya̠bhya̍smi ma̠hnā |
ṛ̠tasya̍ mā pra̠diśo̍ vardhayantyādardi̠ro bhuva̍nā dardarīmi || 4 ||
ā yanmā̍ ve̠nā aru̍hannṛ̠tasyam̠̐ eka̠māsī̍naṃ harya̠tasya̍ pṛ̠ṣṭhe |
viśvettā te̠ sava̍neṣu pra̠vācyā̠ yā ca̠kartha̍ maghavannindra sunva̠te |
pra nū̠naṃ dhā̍vatā̠ pṛtha̠ṅneha yo vo̠ avā̍varīt |
ni ṣīṃ̍ vṛ̠trasya̠ marma̍ṇi̠ vajra̠mindro̍ apīpatat || 7 ||
divaṃ̍ supa̠rṇo ga̠tvāya̠ somaṃ̍ va̠jriṇa̠ ābha̍rat || 8 ||
sa̠mu̠dre a̠ntaḥ śa̍yata u̠dnā vajro̍ a̠bhīvṛ̍taḥ |
cata̍sra̠ ūrjaṃ̍ duduhe̠ payāṃ̍si̠ kva̍ svidasyāḥ para̠maṃ ja̍gāma || 10 ||
de̠vīṃ vāca̍majanayanta de̠vāstāṃ vi̠śvarū̍pāḥ pa̠śavo̍ vadanti |
sā no̍ ma̠ndreṣa̠mūrjaṃ̠ duhā̍nā dhe̠nurvāga̠smānupa̠ suṣṭu̠taitu̍ || 11 ||
sakhe̍ viṣṇo vita̠raṃ vi kra̍masva̠ dyaurde̠hi lo̠kaṃ vajrā̍ya vi̠ṣkabhe̍ |
hanā̍va vṛ̠traṃ ri̠ṇacā̍va̠ sindhū̠nindra̍sya yantu prasa̠ve visṛ̍ṣṭāḥ || 12 ||
tā bā̠hutā̠ na daṃ̠sanā̍ ratharyataḥ sā̠kaṃ sūrya̍sya ra̠śmibhi̍: || 2 ||
pra yo vāṃ̍ mitrāvaruṇā'ji̠ro dū̠to adra̍vat |
na yaḥ sa̠mpṛcche̠ na puna̠rhavī̍tave̠ na saṃ̍vā̠dāya̠ rama̍te |
tasmā̍nno a̠dya samṛ̍teruruṣyataṃ bā̠hubhyāṃ̍ na uruṣyatam || 4 ||
va̠rū̠thyaṃ1 varu̍ṇe̠ chandyaṃ̠ vaca̍: sto̠traṃ rāja̍su gāyata || 5 ||
te hi̍nvire aru̠ṇaṃ jenyaṃ̠ vasvekaṃ̍ pu̠traṃ ti̍sṝ̠ṇām |
u̠bhā yā̍taṃ nāsatyā sa̠joṣa̍sā̠ prati̍ ha̠vyāni̍ vī̠taye̍ || 7 ||
prācīṃ̠ hotrāṃ̍ prati̠rantā̍vitaṃ narā gṛṇā̠nā ja̠mada̍gninā || 8 ||
ā no̍ ya̠jñaṃ di̍vi̠spṛśaṃ̠ vāyo̍ yā̠hi su̠manma̍bhiḥ |
a̠ntaḥ pa̠vitra̍ u̠pari̍ śrīṇā̠no̠3'yaṃ śu̠kro a̍yāmi te || 9 ||
vetya̍dhva̠ryuḥ pa̠thibhī̠ raji̍ṣṭhai̠: prati̍ ha̠vyāni̍ vī̠taye̍ |
adhā̍ niyutva u̠bhaya̍sya naḥ piba̠ śuciṃ̠ somaṃ̠ gavā̍śiram || 10 ||
baṇma̠hām̐ a̍si sūrya̠ baḷā̍ditya ma̠hām̐ a̍si |
ma̠haste̍ sa̠to ma̍hi̠mā pa̍nasyate̠'ddhā de̍va ma̠hām̐ a̍si || 11 ||
baṭ sū̍rya̠ śrava̍sā ma̠hām̐ a̍si sa̠trā de̍va ma̠hām̐ a̍si |
i̠yaṃ yā nīcya̠rkiṇī̍ rū̠pā rohi̍ṇyā kṛ̠tā |
pra̠jā ha̍ ti̠sro a̠tyāya̍mīyu̠rnya1nyā a̠rkama̠bhito̍ viviśre |
bṛ̠haddha̍ tasthau̠ bhuva̍neṣva̠ntaḥ pava̍māno ha̠rita̠ ā vi̍veśa || 14 ||
mā̠tā ru̠drāṇāṃ̍ duhi̠tā vasū̍nāṃ̠ svasā̍di̠tyānā̍ma̠mṛta̍sya̠ nābhi̍: |
pra nu vo̍caṃ ciki̠tuṣe̠ janā̍ya̠ mā gāmanā̍gā̠madi̍tiṃ vadhiṣṭa || 15 ||
de̠vīṃ de̠vebhya̠: parye̠yuṣīṃ̠ gāmā mā̍vṛkta̠ martyo̍ da̠bhrace̍tāḥ || 16 ||
sa na̠ īḷā̍nayā sa̠ha de̠vām̐ a̍gne duva̠syuvā̍ |
tvayā̍ ha svidyu̠jā va̠yaṃ codi̍ṣṭhena yaviṣṭhya |
ā sa̠vaṃ sa̍vi̠turya̍thā̠ bhaga̍syeva bhu̠jiṃ hu̍ve |
a̠yaṃ yathā̍ na ā̠bhuva̠ttvaṣṭā̍ rū̠peva̠ takṣyā̍ |
tamarva̍ntaṃ̠ na sā̍na̠siṃ gṛ̍ṇī̠hi vi̍pra śu̠ṣmiṇa̍m |
taṃ tvā̍jananta mā̠tara̍: ka̠viṃ de̠vāso̍ aṅgiraḥ |
yada̍gne̠ kāni̠ kāni̍ ci̠dā te̠ dārū̍ṇi da̠dhmasi̍ |
upo̠ ṣu jā̠tamārya̍sya̠ vardha̍nama̠gniṃ na̍kṣanta no̠ gira̍: || 1 ||
pra daivo̍dāso a̠gnirde̠vām̐ acchā̠ na ma̠jmanā̍ |
anu̍ mā̠taraṃ̍ pṛthi̠vīṃ vi vā̍vṛte ta̠sthau nāka̍sya̠ sāna̍vi || 2 ||
pra yaṃ rā̠ye ninī̍ṣasi̠ marto̠ yaste̍ vaso̠ dāśa̍t |
sa vī̠raṃ dha̍tte agna ukthaśaṃ̠sinaṃ̠ tmanā̍ sahasrapo̠ṣiṇa̍m || 4 ||
sa dṛ̠ḷhe ci̍da̠bhi tṛ̍ṇatti̠ vāja̠marva̍tā̠ sa dha̍tte̠ akṣi̍ti̠ śrava̍: |
tve de̍va̠trā sadā̍ purūvaso̠ viśvā̍ vā̠māni̍ dhīmahi || 5 ||
yo viśvā̠ daya̍te̠ vasu̠ hotā̍ ma̠ndro janā̍nām |
madho̠rna pātrā̍ pratha̠mānya̍smai̠ pra stomā̍ yantya̠gnaye̍ || 6 ||
aśvaṃ̠ na gī̠rbhī ra̠thyaṃ̍ su̠dāna̍vo marmṛ̠jyante̍ deva̠yava̍: |
u̠bhe to̠ke tana̍ye dasma viśpate̠ parṣi̠ rādho̍ ma̠ghonā̍m || 7 ||
pra maṃhi̍ṣṭhāya gāyata ṛ̠tāvne̍ bṛha̠te śu̠kraśo̍ciṣe |
ā vaṃ̍sate ma̠ghavā̍ vī̠rava̠dyaśa̠: sami̍ddho dyu̠mnyāhu̍taḥ |
udi̍tā̠ yo nidi̍tā̠ vedi̍tā̠ vasvā ya̠jñiyo̍ va̠varta̍ti |
du̠ṣṭarā̠ yasya̍ prava̠ṇe normayo̍ dhi̠yā vāja̠  siṣā̍sataḥ || 11 ||
